objective: Evaluate one frozen historical DRA V1 capital-capacity mechanism on the exact sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Under the same 60 USDT initial cash equity, compare the current one-slot parent, which may deploy at most one 30 USDT lot and leaves the remaining 30 USDT as cash, with one candidate that may deploy at most two independent 30 USDT lots. Keep every DRA V1 signal, cooldown, next-open fill, fee, adverse-slippage and profit-only exit rule unchanged. Use fixed Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and annual 2020-2024 folds. Retain the capacity prior for one later frozen hypothesis only if fee-adjusted total and realized PnL improve with bounded drawdown, holding, underwater-duration, annual-breadth and concentration risk; otherwise close the family. This is post-hoc historical development evidence with no clean OOS, not independent alpha, a candidate, runtime scaling or Trading authorization.

inputs.locator: Decision feature: DRA_V1_MAXIMUM_OPEN_LOT_COUNT_2_WITH_60_USDT_INITIAL_EQUITY. It is fixed before every entry decision: the candidate capacity is exactly 60 USDT, accepts at most two independent 30 USDT lots, and never changes a signal, cooldown, fill, exit, fee, slippage, lot size or initial equity. The parent uses the same 60 USDT initial equity but capacity exactly 30 USDT and therefore at most one lot.

Frozen positive rule: data and parent parity must pass; in both Design and Validation candidate total PnL must be strictly higher, realized PnL must be no lower, blocked entries must be strictly lower, maximum drawdown may be at most parent plus 2.00 percentage points, median and P90 completed holding time may be no higher, and maximum underwater duration may be no higher. The largest positive annual total-PnL delta may contribute at most 50 percent of the sum of positive annual deltas. All realized, unrealized, total, drawdown, utilization, blocked-entry, holding, underwater and terminal-inventory fields must be visible. Every conjunctive gate must pass; there is no rescue variant.
